title: Collatz: actual return composition and Lean carry continuation
body:
## Current checkpoint — actual return composition and exact carry continuation **Full Collatz remains open.** This checkpoint adds an actual transport theorem valid at every return depth with one bounded multiplier, a total arithmetic compiler for arbitrary carry transitions, and a compact ordinary Green map with an explicit infinite-output tail. The common fixed-reference critical estimate and a universally successful witness rule remain open. **Published commit:** [cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb) **Tree:** 6f4ac58af87c1348ae1952116109c015411b1f70 **Parent:** bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d [Checkpoint overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/README.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/REVIEW.md) · [Source snapshot](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json) ### 1. Actual original-source returns compose through a finite reference family Let U be the accelerated odd map, D the existing constant-70 marked band, o(n) the odd part of the original source, E first marked entrance, and Q the actual positive-return pushforward killed at 1. Retain the entire source law sum n^-4 delta_n and its entrance law rho. The common reference is $$ \beta=\sum_{n\ge1,j\ge0}n^{-4} e^{-[\log(j+2)]^2}\mathbf1_D(U^j(o(n)))\delta_{U^j(o(n))}. $$ It retains every original label, collision, and repeated visit. It has every finite logarithmic height moment, and the stronger moment $$ \sum_m\beta(m)\exp\{a[\log(1+\log m)]^2\}<\infty \quad(0k>=0, and every finite p>1, $$ (Q^k\rho)/\beta\in L^p(\beta). $$ The bound is B_(k,p) zeta(7/2), with log B_(k,p)=O_p(25^k(k+1)^2). Truncating original source labels above N costs at most (2/5) B_(k,p) N^(-5/2) in the p-th power of the density norm. The constants are explicit in the imported clock constant; no numerical value of that Diophantine constant is claimed. More strongly, define beta_(s,a) by replacing the source and clock weights with n^-s exp(-a log(j+2)^2). The new actual composition theorem is $$ Q\beta_{s,a}\le K(s-s',a,b)\beta_{s',b}, \qquad s>s'>1,\quad a>25b>0. $$ The proof maps each labeled marked occurrence injectively to its next occurrence. This retains cycles and all endpoint collisions. It also gives the corresponding weighted L^p operator bound. A concrete sequence of parameters makes the product of all transport constants converge. The full entrance law therefore satisfies $$ \boxed{Q^k\rho\le K_0K_{**}\, \beta_{\,2+2^{-k},\,50^{-k}}\quad(k\ge0)} $$ with one finite multiplier independent of k. Every reference at finite depth is finite and has every logarithmic height moment. **Exact remaining loss:** the reference parameters change. Their limit is the full marked occurrence measure with original weights n^-2. Its nonperiodic target atoms are at most zeta(2), but its periodic marked atoms are infinite; the unrestricted limit is not sigma-finite. An escaping marked ray would also force infinite total mass in the nonperiodic restriction. The uniform multiplier is therefore not a fixed finite reference or a proved critical energy bound. The stronger common-reference moment gives a sufficient next target: $$ \|(Q^k\rho)/\beta\|_2^2 =O\!\left((k+1)e^{\gamma[\log\log(k+e^e)]^2}\right), \quad\gamma<1. $$ That estimate would exclude distinct-endpoint survivors. It is not proved here, and cycles require separate exclusion or positive occupation cost. An explicit non-Collatz countermodel records why scalar access, growth, and occupation estimates alone cannot justify the missing interpolation. [Return proof, constants, and source tails](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/RETURN_ATTACK.md) · [ReturnCritical.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/lean/ReturnCritical.lean) · [LognormalClock.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/lean/LognormalClock.lean) ### 2. Every carry gap has an exact physical continuation For a target x=3^p r-c, positive debt c, p>=1, and actual source gap 3r+1=2^a u, use the companion map F(c)=c/2 for even c and (3c-1)/2 for odd c. If K_a counts its odd steps, set $$ d=c+3^{p-1},\quad c'=F^a(d),\quad p'=p-1+K_a(d). $$ The Lean theorem gives the exact physical identity $$ T^a(x)+c'=3^{p'}u,\qquad c'>0. $$ The total finite-word compiler handles arbitrary gaps, debts, exponents, and word lengths. It preserves the actual consumed prefix, literal certificate suffix, and complete-source grade needed by the existing induction. A zero-exponent exit gives a genuine smaller target. The successful grammar now includes a third state E(r)=3r-2, with the loop $$ D_2\xrightarrow{1}E\xrightarrow{2^*}E\xrightarrow{4}D_2. $$ Thus the accepted family contains arbitrarily many gap-four letters and arbitrary runs of twos before a certified successful exit. This is an inductive language theorem, not a bounded enumeration. The exact terminal-source behavior is also formalized: repeated gap-two padding at source 1 simulates T^2 on every positive target. Total arithmetic continuation does not assert that every supplied word reaches a successful exit. [Witness proof and complete grammar](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/WITNESS_ATTACK.md) · [WitnessCritical.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/lean/WitnessCritical.lean) ### 3. A compact actual Green map, with the domain obstruction made exact On the nonperiodic positive odd units, kill transport on entry into any periodic orbit. For actual forward mass transport L, let S=sum L^j. The ordinary path-count input from PR175 gives $$ \|Sa\|_{\ell^1(q^{-s})}\le C_s\|a\|_1,\quad \|(I-Q_X)Sa\|_{\ell^1(q^{-s})} \le C_sX^{39/40-s}\|a\|_1,\quad C_s=\frac{5s}{s-39/40}, $$ for s>39/40 and output cutoff X>=1. This makes S compact between these specified spaces. At s=1, the constant and output tail are 200 and 200 X^(-1/40). The note applies this to PR185's finite immigration correction nu-h=SLd, with explicit finite-source and finite-output approximation errors. The matrix entries still involve actual all-time hitting, so no effective time cutoff is claimed. The explicit convergent ladder $$ n_j=(40\cdot64^j-1)/3,\qquad U(n_j)=5,\qquad U^2(n_j)=1 $$ has vanishing spatial input norm but fixed output delta_5. It proves that L is not closable in the weighted output space. The same ladder gives operator-norm error at least 5^-s for every finite input-height cutoff and every finite ordinary shortcut-clock cutoff. It is not an odd-depth delay example. [Potential proof and operator domains](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/POTENTIAL_ATTACK.md) · [PotentialCritical.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/lean/PotentialCritical.lean) ### Formal evidence and exact scope | New module | Public theorems | Formalized content | |---|---:|---| | ReturnCritical | 4 | Positive return clock and finite complete-fiber quadratic inequalities | | WitnessCritical | 16 | Reflection, arbitrary-gap compiler, grade transfer, successful grammar, terminal behavior | | PotentialCritical | 13 | Actual cofinal ladder, convergence, mass pushforward, vanishing-weight obstruction | | LognormalClock | 9 | All polynomial clock moments, scalar absorption, completed-square parameter loss | | **Total** | **42** | **All public theorem axioms audited** | The fresh replay rebuilt **13 modules**: eight byte-pinned baseline dependencies, four new modules, and one combined audit. All passed under Lean 4.34.1, Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612, with warnings as errors. All 42 audits use only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The infinite measures, general L^p inequalities, return-family composition, imported Diophantine theorem, compactness, and Banach-space nonclosability retain their **reviewed written-proof status**. They are not claimed to be fully formalized by the finite modules. [Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/reports/2026-11-22-critical-pass/lean-check.json) · [Compiler log](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/reports/2026-11-22-critical-pass/lean-build.log) · [Reproduction script](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/check_lean.py) · [Dependency pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cfe70e02f246119a55fb5bf8fd573f148d746beb/research/lean-critical-20261122/DEPENDENCIES.json) The required repository gate was run on a separate clean, complete checkout of the **published commit above**: all **436 tracked files** were present, all **13 Lean receipt source hashes** matched, and **all 11 validation commands passed**. The checkout remained clean with the same commit and tree after validation. This gate checks structure, frozen identities, and selected bounded regressions; it is separate from Lean proof checking. Reproduction: python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py --regressions --receipt /path/outside/checkout/receipt.json. ### Source and review boundary The initial refresh inventories all **122 open PRs**, with targeted reads of the changed PR175, PR176, PR178, PR182, PR185, and PR186 material. The imported polylogarithmic clock is credited to PR176; canonical weighted bounds to PR175; ordinary harmonic immigration to PR185. Their exact heads are recorded in the notes and snapshot. Three parallel lanes developed return, witness, and potential results. The potential lane independently checked the return estimates, countermodel, actual composition constants, and uniformly bounded product; the return and witness lanes independently checked the Green estimates and domain obstruction. The root reviewed the carry compiler and supplied the separate lognormal analysis formalization. No fresh audit of every historical branch is claimed. ---
Earlier PR180 checkpoints and their original evidence ## Wider synthesis checkpoint — 22 November 2026 **Full Collatz remains open.** This checkpoint adds three Lean modules with **22 new public theorems**, plus written analytic results connecting the latest return, complete-witness, and inverse-potential work. It preserves the earlier checkpoints in this PR. Published head: **bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d** Published tree: **913bb2591977eeb379011cae996d0fe09d1f71da** Parent: **d0349de2108abb7c8fb8393c086610e3372df116** [New packet and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/README.md) · [All 121 open PRs at the source snapshot](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json) · [Exact Lean dependencies](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/DEPENDENCIES.json) ### Why this pass The latest branches provide complementary local and conditional results: PR177's remaining alphabet-four witness problem, PR185's physical erasure interfaces, PR183's actual entrance-renewal criterion, PR175's return/reset obstruction, and PR178's Fourier and occupation estimates. This pass pursued three parallel global combinations after reading the research map and correction record. The snapshot inventories every open PR; it is **not** an independent proof review of every branch. The detailed source reads and exact heads are listed in the three notes. ### 1. A uniform bound on actual marked occupation For the accelerated odd map $U$, let $M(n,N)$ count visits to the marked band in a finite injective prefix of $N$ states. The new deduction gives an absolute constant $C$ such that $$ M(n,N)\le C\,\frac{N}{\log(N+2)} $$ for **every positive odd source and every finite injective prefix**. The bound has no source-dependent eventual horizon and does not require predecessor density or joint mixing. The Lean module proves an explicit Fourier denominator, the finite Fejer-kernel count, its complete quantitative bound, and the unchanged-source weighted accounting. The optimization to the displayed logarithmic rate is a **written proof**. For a finite original source measure $\mu$, retaining each original atom and all endpoint collisions gives the corresponding pre-repeat discounted bound $$ \sum_{j\ge0}r^j\|\nu_j\| \ll \frac{\|\mu\|_1}{(1-r)\log(1/(1-r))}. $$ The note states the full actual-time cycle contribution separately; a pre-repeat estimate is never applied to an infinite periodic tail. **A new finite-moment reference retains those tails.** If $\mu$ has finite fourth logarithmic height moment, then for every $\eta>0$, $$ \alpha_\eta =\sum_{j\ge0} \frac{\widetilde\nu_j}{(j+1)^5[\log(j+2)]^\eta} $$ has finite fourth logarithmic height moment. Here $\widetilde\nu_j$ is the **full actual marked packet**, without a repeat cutoff. The proof uses the uniform occupation bound before the first repeat. After a repeat, every future value lies in the earlier finite prefix, and the coefficient tail controls its fourth-power height. The new repeated-tail module checks the actual-map containment and height estimate; the infinite measure sum remains written mathematics. This constructs a reference with the needed moment property. The unresolved step is an **aggregate endpoint estimate** for its induced-return transport. Comparing each source only with one later occurrence is quantitatively too weak and is not asserted to be necessary for an aggregate proof. [Return proof, constants, full periodic tails, and remaining transport comparison](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/RETURN_SYNTHESIS.md) [ReturnSynthesis.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/lean/ReturnSynthesis.lean) · [RepeatedTail.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/lean/RepeatedTail.lean) ### 2. Arbitrary prefix erasure within the complete supplied-witness induction For $$ n=2^ku-1,\qquad x=2^{k-r}u-1,\qquad 00, $$ an actual endpoint merger with independent clocks, $$ T^a(3^{k-r}u-1)=T^b(3^ku-1), $$ compiles to $$ T^{k-r+a}(x)=T^{k+b}(n),\qquad 2x+1\le n. $$ The Lean proof places this all-length erasure inside the complete-source interval induction after one physical source halving. It preserves the **entire supplied odd certificate** and proves the exact decrease of the initial-even grade. It allows an even partner and deletion of the entire initial run when the partner stays positive. The module also proves the exact unresolved carry pair $(r,9r+2)$ and an all-time example at $7$ showing that requiring equal endpoint clocks would exclude a valid asynchronous erasure. A **total successful dispatcher** for all remaining alphabet-four words is still unproved. [Witness synthesis and the unbounded carry obstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/WITNESS_SYNTHESIS.md) · [WitnessSynthesis.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/lean/WitnessSynthesis.lean) ### 3. Exact canonical normalization and a bound over every prefix clock Let $D$ be the source-qualified ternary stationary density, $V$ the canonical least excessive majorant of the unit indicator, and $G=\lim_jP^jV$ its ordinary harmonicization. Writing $$ \kappa=\left(\operatorname*{ess\,inf}_{\mathbb Z_3^\times}D\right)^{-1}, $$ the new written proof gives $$ V=\kappa D\quad\text{almost everywhere}, \qquad V_k(q)\le\kappa D_s(q)\quad(s\ge k+1), \qquad \frac{V(q)}{2\kappa}\le G(q)\le V(q). $$ The latter comparisons hold at **every ordinary positive integer**, using finite-cylinder averaging. Thus harmonicization retains an absolute fraction even when the target changes. This is not an assignment of ordinary values through an arbitrary almost-everywhere representative. For a test $H$ periodic modulo $M=3^t$, inverse depth $d$, and an upper coefficient bound $\Omega\ge0$, the note also proves $$ |P^d_{\mathcal F}H(q)| \le \left[q(L-d+1)+2M\Omega+M9^d(2/3)^L\right]\|H\|_{1,M}. $$ This sums all actual prefix clocks, including repeated sources at different totals. The choice $$ L=6d+\max\!\left(0,\left\lceil\log_{3/2}(M/q)\right\rceil\right) $$ makes the tail at most $q(64/81)^d$. At a component's least odd ternary unit, an input vanishing on multiples of three permits $\Omega=1$. The displayed resolution term and the growing number of effective clocks remain. The result does not establish the critical ordinary upper bound or the invariant label's finite five-energy estimate. Component covariance and the exact normalization $\inf_{\mathcal C\cap\mathbb Z_3^\times}V=1$ are proved in the note, with their scope stated. [Potential and energy synthesis](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/research/lean-wide-pass-20261122/ENERGY_SYNTHESIS.md) ### Formal replay and publication checks - **Lean 4.34.1**, commit 5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52. - **Mathlib** d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612. - **13 modules rebuilt in a fresh output directory**, including six baseline modules, three byte-identical vendor modules, the three new modules, and the combined audit. - **22 new public theorem audits passed:** eight return/accounting theorems, nine witness theorems, and five repeated-orbit theorems. - Warnings are errors. Printed theorem dependencies use only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound; no nonstandard axiom or proof hole is accepted. - The optimized asymptotic, infinite measure summations, stationary-density arguments, and all-clock analytic estimate are **written proofs**, not claimed as Lean-verified. - The return and witness notes received independent mathematical review; a separate review checked the canonical normalization, every-point comparison, full-clock constants, and least-unit specialization. [Fresh Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/reports/2026-11-22-wide-pass/lean-check.json) · [Compiler and axiom log](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bfba8feaefb3d0910456cdd92d2afcf9e8785b4d/reports/2026-11-22-wide-pass/lean-build.log) After publication, the exact remote commit was fetched into a **clean complete checkout** with **421 tracked files**. All 13 compiled source hashes matched the published tree. The required repository gate python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py --regressions --receipt <outside-checkout> passed **all 11 commands**, and the checkout stayed clean. This gate checks repository structure and selected bounded regressions; the separate Lean replay is the formal proof evidence. Gate interval: 2026-11-21T23:15:57.686904+00:00 through 2026-11-21T23:16:02.892185+00:00. External gate receipt SHA-256: e81b8e31a68a7608cad1737c3f305a9b4ba89e47a1cc368169b8e094e218d5e8. ### Remaining global steps The three active routes now have explicit remaining obligations: 1. Bound **actual aggregate returned mass** by the constructed finite-moment reference at the critical return-count scale, retaining the nontrivial-cycle alternative. 2. Supply lower-grade **physical mergers for every remaining complete witness**, including the unbounded carry phase. 3. Prove the **critical ordinary upper estimate** for the canonical potential at moving marked targets, or establish the invariant label's finite five energy. None is inserted as an axiom or reported as proved. ---

Uniform natural predecessor density For absolute constants $c,C>0$, every positive ternary-unit target $a$ satisfies $$ X\ge Ca\ \Longrightarrow\ \#\{0 Earlier checkpoint record ## Earlier checkpoint: actual forward-band populations and Lean component descent **Full Collatz remains open.** This pass builds on PR173 at `fa0c9e2a2851e6324391e39c17afcb5913185aec`. Final published head: `9010a8790535002b6d9ff92304f0ba289e2e98fe`. Tree: `3bbbaeb5d24ce44241a0835336bfcb744ab77e27`. Two checkpoints were pushed: [`5c0b59b`](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/5c0b59be54d7f54351141c407f84584373a06d80) and [`9010a87`](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/9010a8790535002b6d9ff92304f0ba289e2e98fe). ### What this adds 1. **Written analytic theorem, independently reviewed:** an absolute γ > 0 gives every positive ternary-unit target arbitrarily large octaves containing at least γ·2^d/(d+1)^2 distinct predecessors in the constant-10 band above 2^d. All reach the supplied target at one common ordinary shortcut clock ≤ 15(d+1). This lies inside PR173's actual constant-70 section. The onset and witness octaves may depend on the target. A separate appendix also retains unit sources. 2. **Unconditional Lean component descent:** for every k ≥ 2, n = 2^(3k)+2^(2k)−1 is marked and has the smaller representative m = (n−1)/2, with T^(3k)(n) = T^(3k−1)(m). A general theorem proves that saving one ordinary clock with the same odd count and endpoint places the alternative source below the original dyadic floor. 3. **Unconditional Lean transport and carry identities:** a total inverse construction restores arbitrary ternary precision, and carry height remains constant through each complete rising odd run, including the marked returns it contains. 4. **Exact global criterion:** with V_d(t) counting actual section points in octave d that have not hit one through t, Collatz is equivalent, via the analytic population theorem, to: there exists d₀ such that every d ≥ d₀ admits t with (d+1)^3 V_d(t) < 2^d. The survivor upper bound is still unproved. ### Final global closing pass - The new Lean parity bridge proves an unconditional odd-psi comparison for the solved phase. It also proves that the complementary transfer is the **same original odd query at unchanged rank**. Applying a strictly lower-rank induction hypothesis there would be circular. - A separately reviewed analytic consequence of the uniform predecessor-density bound gives `sum_i 1/q_i ≤ 22/c₀` on every nonrepeating odd unit orbit. Its binary logarithmic phases consequently approach an irrational rotation and are equidistributed. Its marked visits would be infinite but have zero frequency in odd time. This does not exclude a summable divergent orbit or another cycle. - A matched bounded completion search left the **same** frontier with and without the new phase terminal through all six binary refinements: 2,400 unresolved cells at modulus 92,160. Bounds were 100 times the root coefficients/constants and 100,000 nodes; no node cutoff bound was reached. This is bounded search evidence, not a global impossibility result. ### Evidence boundaries The analytic population theorem derives from PR180's selected-density construction and its stated Tao fine-scale mixing input. It does not assume fixed-total conditional mixing and is not yet formalized in Lean. The Lean survivor criterion therefore takes `DenseBandFans` as an explicit hypothesis; no axiom asserts it. The exact transport, family descent, and carry theorems are unconditional. A common endpoint proves component descent, not that the smaller representative occurs later on the larger source's forward trajectory. ### Validation - Fresh compilation of all **11** local Lean modules with Lean 4.34.1, pinned Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`, and warnings treated as errors. - Printed axiom audits contain only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; no sorry/admit/custom axiom or native-decision shortcut in the packet. - Exact arithmetic clouds passed for targets 1, 5, 7: respectively 82, 80, 81 distinct sources in octaves 185, 207, 156, at common clocks 819, 910, 681.
